landing.heroTitle: Tu propio estudio de dramas anime con IA
landing.heroLead1: Pega una novela o escribe una frase: la IA crea la estructura de episodios, el diseño de personajes, el storyboard y el vídeo.
landing.heroLead2: Personajes coherentes de principio a fin, precios transparentes en todo el proceso.

landing.flowStudioDesc: Del guion al montaje final, todo en un mismo lugar
landing.flowToolsDesc: Texto a vídeo e imagen a vídeo para planos rápidos

landing.capSectionDesc: Generar un clip suelto es el terreno de los proveedores de modelos. Nosotros construimos la línea de producción: entra una novela, salen episodios terminados.
landing.capScriptDesc: Novela o una frase → estructura de episodios → diseño de personajes → storyboard → generación por lotes. Cada paso es editable y repetible.
landing.capCharacterDesc: Al vincular el diseño de referencia se inyecta en cada plano: la cara no cambia entre planos ni entre episodios.

landing.capAssetsDesc: Los resultados se guardan en la biblioteca de recursos, los diseños de personaje se etiquetan para reutilizarlos entre proyectos y la obra puede continuar en el siguiente episodio.
landing.capAiDesc: Marca de agua en los fotogramas finales y metadatos en el archivo, cumpliendo los requisitos de etiquetado de contenido generado.
landing.pipeSectionTitle: Seis pasos de la idea al montaje final
landing.pipeSectionDesc: Unos 30 minutos de trabajo manual; 2 horas o menos de principio a fin, incluida la cola de generación.
landing.pipe1Desc: Pega una novela o una idea de una línea y elige el formato
landing.pipe2Desc: La IA la divide en 3–6 episodios editables línea a línea y guardados automáticamente

landing.pipe5Desc: Elige modelos y presupuesto y envía todos los planos de una vez
landing.pipe6Desc: Descarga plano a plano o el episodio completo en zip con manifest

toolUpscale.errRegionFirst: Marca primero la zona de los subtítulos en el fotograma

adminMarket.title: Script Market
adminMarket.hint: Review works, curate categories and tags, run promo slots and settle withdrawals. Writes take effect on the storefront immediately.
adminMarket.confirmDisable: Disable “{name}”? History and stats are kept.
adminMarket.reviewHint: Only pending works can be reviewed. Approving lists them; rejecting sends them back to the creator (no re-judging).
adminMarket.rejectNeedsNote: A reason is required when rejecting
adminMarket.categoriesHint: Categories are a small curated list; disabling keeps historical work references.
adminMarket.tagsHint: Tags are a flat list; deleting one removes it from every work and cannot be undone.
adminMarket.promotionsHint: Promo slots drive storefront banners; disabling only changes status and keeps view/click stats.
adminMarket.slotLocked: Slot cannot be changed after creation (PATCH has no slot field); create a new entry instead.
adminMarket.withdrawalsHint: Flow: pending → approved → paid, no skipping. Payouts happen in the payment channel; record the reference here.
adminMarket.rejectReasonRequired: A reason is required when rejecting
adminMarket.dashStatusFilterHint: Filter the work list by this status
adminMarket.resubmitBlocked: Price must be greater than 0 before review

adminSkills.title: Skill Featured
adminSkills.hint: Toggles take effect immediately on the storefront plaza filter; only platform cards can be featured.
adminSkills.platformOnly: This list contains platform cards only (space_id is null); team cards are managed by their creators.

adminAudit.title: Audit log
adminAudit.hint: Only admin write operations on /v1/ops/ are recorded (GET is not stored). Payloads are redacted (password/token/secret/authorization) and truncated at 8KB.
adminAudit.adminIdInvalid: Admin ID must be numeric (the id shown in the admin list)
adminAudit.empty: No audit records match the current filters.
adminAudit.needRole: Requires the ops or super role to view audit logs

adminAdmins.title: Administrators
adminAdmins.hint: Roles: super manages admins and everything; ops can write operational data; viewer is read-only. Disabling an account or changing its password bumps tokenVersion, so tokens already issued to it stop working. Admin endpoints are super-only.
adminAdmins.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters
adminAdmins.needSuper: Requires the super role to manage admin accounts

adminConfig.title: Config center
adminConfig.hint: Global key/value config (app_configs). Saved values are visible immediately through GET /v1/ops/config/:key. Values are JSON: wrap plain strings in double quotes.
adminConfig.deleteConfirm: Delete config "{key}"? Readers will get exists=false afterwards; make sure no code depends on it.
adminConfig.keyInvalid: Key must be 1-64 characters with no whitespace
adminConfig.fDescriptionPlaceholder: What this config affects, for whoever comes next
adminConfig.valueHint: Validated with JSON.parse before saving: write objects, arrays and numbers directly; strings need double quotes.
adminConfig.empty: No config entries yet. Use "New config" to add one.
adminConfig.needRole: Requires the ops or super role to modify config
adminConfig.truncated: Showing the first {n} of {total} entries; search by key or maintain them in batches.
adminConfig.fDefaultOnlyHint: Only rows whose module is empty (the global fallback). Cannot be combined with a module filter.

adminPrices.title: Pricing
adminPrices.hint: A tier is model × mode × resolution × duration_s. Price changes take effect immediately; to stop selling, uncheck Active instead of deleting.
adminPrices.empty: No price tiers match the current filters.
adminPrices.deleteConfirm: Delete tier "{name}"? It can no longer be ordered; existing credit records are unaffected.
adminPrices.createHint: Available tiers come from the model catalog (modes / resolution_options / durations); amounts are set by ops and re-validated by the API.
adminPrices.noModes: This model declares no modes, so no tier can be created (add its parameter catalog on the Models tab first).
adminPrices.errCredits: Credits are required and must be a non-negative integer
adminPrices.errStrikeEmpty: Strike price cannot be cleared (the API does not accept null); use 0 for none

adminUsers.title: Users
adminUsers.hint: Search by nickname, user ID, or phone. Phone numbers are always masked. Deleted users can only be restored, not re-activated.
adminUsers.banConfirm: Ban user "{name}"? Their next request will fail with 401.
adminUsers.restorePrompt: New nickname (optional; the original was anonymized on deletion)
adminUsers.needRole: This action requires the ops or super role.

adminWaitlist.title: Waitlist
adminWaitlist.hint: The waitlist stores only a phone HMAC. The platform cannot see plaintext numbers or send messages; marking a row only records that ops already invited this person.
adminWaitlist.needRole: Marking an invite requires the ops or super role.

adminInvites.title: Invite codes
adminInvites.hint: Bulk issue codes: up to 50 per batch, 8 characters without confusable glyphs such as 0/O/1/I. Disabling takes effect immediately, and exhausted codes cannot be re-enabled.
adminInvites.expiresHint: Leave the expiry empty for never; times are entered in local time and converted to UTC ISO.
adminInvites.createdHint: These codes are shown only once — copy and distribute them now.
adminInvites.copyManual: Automatic copy is unavailable — copy the code manually
adminInvites.exhaustedHint: This code is exhausted and cannot be re-enabled
adminInvites.disableConfirm: Disable invite code {code}? It stops working immediately.
adminInvites.creditsRange: Credits must be an integer in {min}..{max}
adminInvites.maxUsesRange: Max uses must be an integer in {min}..{max}
adminInvites.countRange: Count must be an integer in {min}..{max}
adminInvites.needRole: Managing invite codes requires the ops or super role.
adminInvites.updateFailed: Failed to update the invite code

adminAiLabel.title: AI label audit
adminAiLabel.hint: Source: tasks.results[].meta.ai_label written by the worker — not a second tracking table. This panel audits, it never backfills. The API scans at most 5000 most-recent rows, so narrower ranges are more accurate.
adminAiLabel.needRole: Viewing this audit requires the ops role or higher.
adminAiLabel.loadFailed: Failed to load AI label data
